descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S26 「Save & Extract 失败、慢、重试或点两次：口述保留，任务不变或只应用一次，有清楚的提示」 Save & Extract fails, is slow, is retried or is tapped twice: dictation kept, tasks unchanged or applied once, a clear message

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U14 When task extraction fails or is slow, the physician sees a visible in-progress state and then a clear message and can retry (or the backup model answers, recorded per 3.9); …（UAT 3.5；UAT OAT-03）
  • U3 No duplicates: closing a task adds no new task for the same item, and Save & Extract never adds a task that is already on the list, open or closed（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U10 Never invent, never drop: a task made from the dictation contains nothing that was not dictated (no added dose, route, frequency or urgency, no supplied decision) and keeps what was dictated, includi …（UAT 3.4；TFA-94229 R8；TFA-94229 R9） — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both（UAT TC-22 step 4；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident, each with typed tasks 'follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks'; trackActionRequests on ai/parsing:extractTasks (e2e/support/action-observer.ts) with failFirst, then a mocked success that closes BMP and PT a …

When (1) Type the UAT bedside text and tap Save & Extract while the call fails. (2) Tap again (mocked success). (3) Tap again without changing the text (same mocked answer). (4) On a fresh chart, tap Save & Extract twice within 300 ms. (5) With the 35 s delay, watch the screen until the answer. Each in both contexts; …

Then (1) 'Notes saved, but task extraction failed. Tap again to retry.'; the encounter text still in the box and stored; the stored tasks deep-equal to before (nothing closed, nothing added). (2) BMP and PT done once, the diet task once, weight open. (3) Nothing added or changed. (4) One extractTasks request, or the button disabled while 'Extracting…'; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U14 from 3.5 / OAT-03 ('the physician is never left waiting with nothing'), U3 as read in Q5 (c), U10 (no dictated words lost). Judged on the stored tasks and the visible text, with the model mocked, so this is evidence for the app, not the extractor. The Hospital failure message alone is already asserted by the existing spec in S17; …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-c（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S26 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-c。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-c。

UAT item: TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-22/S26

Save & Extract fails, is slow, is retried or is tapped twice: dictation kept, tasks unchanged or applied once, a clear message

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for pr); TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress)

本地新 lane newspec-c：newspec-c/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（newspec-c/plan.json，automatable: yes）：New Playwright spec per context: fresh account, chart with 'follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks'. extractTasks at the socket: (1) fail -> 'Notes saved, but task extraction failed. Tap again to retry.', text kept and stored, tasks deep-equal; (2) success closing BMP + PT and adding the diet task; (3) same answer again -> nothing changes; (4) fresh chart, two taps within 300 ms -> one request or a disabled 'Extracting…' button, diet task once; (5) answer delayed 35 s -> an in-progress state visible the whole time, then the result. Judged on the then only; a failure message left on screen after a successful retry is recorded (not in the then). (4)'s two taps are fired inside the page, 120 ms apart. — Scripted socket answers (fail / success / delayed), DOM reads and JWT reads.

Detail:

Re-run 16:48 JST after review, judged on the then only: Hospital 9/9 + 2/2, Nursing Home 9/9 + 2/2. (1) 'Notes saved, but task extraction failed. Tap again to retry.', text kept in the box and stored, stored tasks unchanged; (2) BMP and PT done once, the diet task once, weight open; (3) a repeat tap changes nothing; (4) two taps fired inside the page 121-122 ms apart (the earlier Hospital run's taps were 515 ms apart) -> one extractTasks request, button already disabled at the second tap, diet task once; (5) 'Extracting…' throughout a 35 s answer, then the result. Separate finding, recorded only (not in step (2)'s then): in Nursing Home the failed extraction also raises the global red banner, and that banner is still on screen after the successful retry (reproduced in 5 runs and by the reviewer); Hospital clears its message.

产品问题：Finding for Quinn to place (U14 'clear message' or U8 'Nursing Home as well as Hospital', U8 gated by TFA-92592); not part of S26's verdict. Nursing Home Encounter: Save & Extract fails, the physician taps again and it succeeds - the screen shows '✓ Tasks updated — 2 completed, 1 added' under a red banner at the top still saying 'Notes saved, but task extraction failed. Tap again to retry.' until dismissed by hand (snf useSaveAndExtract.ts:118-120 also calls reportClientError, and the banner is never cleared on success). Hospital does not raise the banner.

证据：附了 5 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): failFirst / mocked / 35 s delayed ai/parsing:extractTasks answers through action-observer and backend reads on a fresh local account; dev has no admin key and no action mock, and a real failure cannot be forced there, so it runs on the local stack only…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
